items.title: Amaravati capital & Polavaram — 2026 status
items.body:
**Amaravati (capital).** The **AP Reorganization (Amendment) Act, 2026** granted Amaravati permanent statutory status as the **sole capital**, ending the earlier 'three-capitals' ambiguity. It was passed in the 2026 Budget session of Parliament and signed by President Droupadi Murmu on **6 April 2026**, amending **Section 5(2)** of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014. Amaravati is also getting the **Quantum Valley Tech Park** (2026) with **IBM, TCS and IIT Madras** to build India's largest quantum computer.

**Polavaram Project (Godavari).** Multipurpose national irrigation project; the **new diaphragm wall was completed on 2 April 2026** and **Earth-Cum-Rock-Fill (ECRF) dam** works commenced. Reservoir FRL 150 ft msl; spillway capacity ~36 lakh cusecs.

| Item | 2026 status |
|---|---|
| Amaravati | Sole capital by statute (Act 2026) |
| Quantum Valley | IBM + TCS + IIT Madras |
| Polavaram diaphragm wall | Completed 2 Apr 2026 |
| Polavaram ECRF dam | Works commenced |
keyPoints: AP Reorganization (Amendment) Act, 2026 made Amaravati the sole capital; President's assent 6 April 2026.
The Act amended Section 5(2) of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014.
Amaravati Quantum Valley Tech Park (2026): IBM, TCS, IIT Madras — India's largest quantum computer.
Polavaram new diaphragm wall completed 2 April 2026; ECRF dam works began.
Polavaram is on the Godavari; FRL 150 ft, spillway ~36 lakh cusecs.

items.title: AP welfare schemes & agriculture (2025–26)
items.body:
The NDA (**TDP–JSP–BJP**) government under CM **N. Chandrababu Naidu** (office from June 2024) is delivering its **'Super Six'** welfare guarantees — student/parent support **Thalliki Vandanam**, subsidised LPG **Deepam-2**, farmer income support **Annadata Sukhibhava**, women's assistance **Adabidda Nidhi**, a youth allowance, and **free bus travel for women**.

**Rythanna Meekosam** (inaugurated **24 Nov 2025**) is a farmer-empowerment programme on a **Five-Point Formula**: water security, demand-based cultivation, agri-tech adoption, food-processing expansion, government support. It promotes drones/precision spraying and price procurement for tobacco, mango, onion and coconut. At its launch, **PM-Kisan Annadata Sukhibhava** was reported to have disbursed **over ₹3,200 crore to 68+ lakh farmers**.
keyPoints: 'Super Six' = flagship welfare guarantees of the TDP–JSP–BJP government (from June 2024).

items.title: AP investment leadership & industry (FY26)
items.body:
In the first nine months of **FY26 (Apr–Dec 2025)**, **Andhra Pradesh topped** India's proposed-investment rankings with about **25.3%** of ₹26.6 lakh crore nationwide — ahead of **Odisha (13.1%)** and **Maharashtra (12.8%)**; the top three held 51.2% (Bank of Baroda report). National proposals rose 11.5% YoY, aided by higher capex, lower taxes and **GST 2.0**.

The **30th CII Partnership Summit 2025** (14–15 Nov 2025) was held at **Andhra University Grounds, Visakhapatnam**, organised with **DPIIT** and the AP govt, inaugurated by **Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan** — 2,500+ delegates from 77 countries; theme **'Technology, Trust, and Trade'**. Priority sectors: **green hydrogen, semiconductors, precision medicine**. AP also accounts for about **60% of India's marine product exports**.
keyPoints: AP ranked 1st for proposed investments in FY26 (Apr–Dec 2025) with ~25.3% share.
Odisha (13.1%) and Maharashtra (12.8%) followed; top-3 = 51.2%.

items.title: AP infrastructure milestones (2026)
items.body:
Three headline infrastructure milestones landed in 2026:

| Project | Milestone | Date |
|---|---|---|
| **South Coast Railway (SCoR)** | New zone operational; HQ **Visakhapatnam** | 1 Jun 2026 |

items.body:

items.title: AP Budget 2026-27 at a glance
items.body:
The **Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27** was presented on **14 February 2026** by Finance Minister **Payyavula Keshav**.

| Aggregate | 2026-27 |
|---|---|
| GSDP (current prices) | Rs 19,75,073 crore (~12% growth) |
| Total expenditure (excl. debt repayment) | Rs 3,10,058 crore (+12% over RE 2025-26) |
| Fiscal deficit | 3.8% of GSDP (Rs 75,868 crore) |
| Revenue deficit | 1.1% of GSDP (Rs 22,003 crore) |

**Major sectoral allocations**

| Head | Allocation |
|---|---|
| Education, Sports, Arts & Culture | Rs 35,673 crore |
| Health & Family Welfare | Rs 19,630 crore |
| Agriculture & Allied Activities | Rs 14,433 crore |
| Annadata Sukhibhava (scheme) | Rs 6,600 crore |

The largest increases in capital outlay were for **irrigation & flood control, water supply & sanitation, and urban development**. GSDP in 2025-26 was ~Rs 17.62 trillion (~10% growth).

items.title: AP vision, governance initiatives & 2025–26 administrative changes
items.body:
**Vision & anti-poverty:** *Swarna Andhra @2047* (launched Nov 2024) targets a wealthy/healthy/happy AP by 2047, on ten 'Padi Sutralu' (zero poverty, employment, HR/skill, water & energy security, deep-tech growth). *P4* (Public-Private-People Partnership) has the top 10% 'Margadarsis' support the bottom 20% 'Bangaru Kutumbalu', targeting zero poverty by 2029.

**Digital governance:** *Mana Mitra* WhatsApp service (launched 30 Jan 2025; no. 9552300009) grew from 161 to 700 services (15 Aug 2025) — certificates, bills, temple bookings. *RTGS* (Real Time Governance Society) revived under IT Minister Nara Lokesh.

**Administrative changes:** districts rose 26→28 on 31 Dec 2025 — new **Polavaram** (HQ Rampachodavaram, from Alluri Sitharama Raju) and **Markapuram** (HQ Markapuram, from Prakasam); **Madanapalle** is the HQ of **Annamayya** district (not a separate district — the '29th district' proposal was not notified). **28 zilla parishads** effective 25 Sep 2026. New revenue divisions (31 Dec 2025): Rampachodavaram, Markapuram, Kanigiri. Cabinet (Sep 2026) approved four new police commissionerates (incl. Guntur, Kurnool, Rajamahendravaram).
keyPoints: Swarna Andhra @2047 — launched Nov 2024; ten 'Padi Sutralu'; wealthy/healthy/happy AP by 2047.
P4 (Public-Private-People Partnership) — Margadarsis (top 10%) support Bangaru Kutumbalu (bottom 20%); zero poverty by 2029.
Mana Mitra — WhatsApp governance from 30 Jan 2025; 161→700 services (15 Aug 2025). RTGS revived under Nara Lokesh.
28 districts w.e.f. 31 Dec 2025 — Polavaram (HQ Rampachodavaram), Markapuram (HQ Markapuram); Madanapalle = HQ of Annamayya, not a district.
28 zilla parishads from 25 Sep 2026; four new police commissionerates approved Sep 2026 (Guntur, Kurnool, Rajamahendravaram).

items.title: AP key events month-by-month (Oct 2025 → Sep 2026)
items.body: A chronological recap of high-yield Andhra Pradesh current events for APPSC Group-1 (Oct 2025 → Sep 2026).
keyPoints: Oct 2025: Cyclone Montha formed ~24 Oct; landfall near Kakinada night of 28–29 Oct (winds 90–100 kmph); 3 deaths, ~1.8M affected across 249 mandals, crops flattened over ~87,000 ha.
Nov 2025: 30th CII Partnership Summit, AU Engineering Grounds Visakhapatnam (14–15 Nov), inaugurated by VP C. P. Radhakrishnan — 613 MoUs worth ₹13,25,716 cr, ~16,31,188 jobs.
Dec 2025: Ponduru Khadi (Srikakulam) gets GI tag; Cabinet ratifies ₹7,387 cr Amaravati loan, 10% road cess, DA hike.
Jan 2026: NITI Fiscal Health Index — AP in bottom five (Odisha No.1); Investment Friendliness Index — AP 6th (large states)/8th overall; Padma Awards 2026 announced (131 awardees).
Feb 2026: Budget 2026-27 presented 14 Feb by FM Payyavula Keshav, outlay ₹3,32,205 cr; School Education highest allocation ~₹32,308 cr; ~₹6,000 cr to Amaravati; three City Economic Regions.
Mar 2026: Cabinet 50% one-time waiver of interest on property-tax arrears 2025-26 (deadline 31 Mar).

Apr 2026: Google broke ground on US$15bn AI data-centre hub, Visakhapatnam (~28 Apr); Cabinet cleared 34 proposals (aviation policy, organ-transplant law, revised Polavaram funding); AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Act 2026 — Amaravati sole capital, Presidential assent 6 Apr; Justice Lisa Gill sworn in as 5th CJ of AP High Court (25 Apr).

May 2026: Omnibus Ease of Doing Business Act 2026 + Pedestrian Safety Policy; 33.33% BC quota in ULBs + direct election of Mayors/chairpersons; 16th Finance Commission ₹28,785 cr to AP local bodies (2026-31).
Jun 2026: Rules issued for direct election of Mayors/municipal chairpersons; SEC A. C. Punetha directed readiness for 2026 local body polls.
Jul 2026: Talliki Vandanam ₹10,120.78 cr credited to ~42.70 lakh mothers, ~67.47 lakh students.

Aug 2026: PM Modi inaugurated Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport, Bhogapuram (1 Aug; ₹5,640 cr, GMR, 6M pax/yr) — projects worth ₹17,900 cr+ dedicated; commercial ops shifted Vizag→Bhogapuram 17 Aug.
Sep 2026: Cabinet approved four new Police Commissionerates (Guntur, Kurnool, Rajamahendravaram +1), HNSS revised sanction ~₹463.55 cr, and 815 Junior Assistant posts.
Appointments 2026: Chief Justice AP HC = Justice Lisa Gill; Chief Secretary = G. Sai Prasad (from 1 Mar); APPSC Chairperson = A. R. Anuradha (retd IPS).
